name: refresh-semantic-model
cost: Free (GPL-3.0). Table and partition refreshes need Power BI Premium, Premium Per User or Fabric capacity
works_with: Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI, through the plugin marketplace
short: Has your agent trigger, watch, check and troubleshoot Power BI semantic model refreshes with the Fabric CLI and the Enhanced Refresh API.
what: This skill teaches your agent to refresh a Power BI semantic model or dataset: the whole model, chosen tables or single partitions. It runs a baseline DAX query first, triggers the refresh with the `fab` CLI, watches the status and runs the query again to confirm new data arrived. It also covers the refresh types, two-phase refreshes for large models, cancelling, and the usual failures.
who: Power BI and Fabric developers who look after model refreshes. You need workspace contributor access and the Fabric CLI, so it won't help if you only use the Power BI portal.
needs: Premium, Premium Per User or Fabric capacity for table, partition and other enhanced options
`uv`, if you use the bundled refresh script

steps.title: Or use Copilot CLI
steps.text: Add the marketplace, then install a plugin by name with `copilot plugin install`.

steps.title: Ask for a refresh
steps.text: Your agent looks up the workspace and model IDs, takes a baseline, triggers the refresh and checks the result.

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.text: Ask it to run a two-phase refresh on a large model: a `dataOnly` refresh with `partialBatch`, then a `calculate` refresh, comparing row counts before and after.

watch: The README warns the plugins change weekly and versions 26.26 to 26.38 are a breaking transition. Pin 26.25 or earlier if you need the old structure.
Refreshes run against your real workspace. A `clearValues` refresh empties tables, and a `dataOnly` refresh clears calculated tables until a `calculate` refresh rebuilds them.
Pro capacity allows 8 refreshes a day and only full-model refreshes.
A refresh that succeeds with no new data usually means the upstream source or ETL hasn't run yet.
